title: Remove mandatory policy-change justification end to end
outcome: Policy settings change without a human-authored reason or synthetic replacement; remove the associated reason contract rather than retain a legacy path.
acceptance: Policy-change reason is removed from the applicable Engram domain/storage/API/CLI and TermAl settings/request paths, with no hidden automatic reason, deprecated alias, compatibility shim, or fallback.

Required gates and independent reviews cover changed inputs, with host integration coordinated at explicit source-freeze boundaries; no live-store mutation, install, restart or Git publication is implied.

Tests and documentation match the reason-free contract while preserving actual completion-policy enforcement, concurrency guards and exact retry behavior; unrelated evaluation rationales and operational refusal reasons remain intact.

completion.summary: Removed mandatory policy-change justification end to end in Engram and coordinated TermAl source changes, without aliases, autofill or compatibility adapters. Reason-free CLI/docs/website, preserved policy/CAS/replay invariants and historical canonical bytes. Required gates and independent reviews passed; final independent acceptance passed all three criteria. Implementation complete; not committed, installed or live-deployed.
